intro: Comfort meets smart design in our Glee sofa. With soft cushioning, stylish two-tone upholstery, and a compact build—it’s perfect for modern, mindful living.

features.title: Sink-in softness
features.text: Plush foam seat and back offer a cozy, cushioned feel that makes sitting down something to look forward to, every time.

features.title: Posture-perfect armrests
features.text: Flat armrests offer better ergonomic support, letting your arms rest comfortably while encouraging proper sitting posture.

features.title: Shoulder-level comfort
features.text: A supportive mid-back design relieves pressure from your shoulders, making it ideal for long chats or quick power naps.

features.title: Two-tone, two-texture charm
features.text: A stylish blend of soft fabric and smooth synthetic leather creates contrast and character that complements any interior.

features.title: Strength beneath the softness
features.text: Built on a durable pinewood frame, your sofa stays strong and stable through years of use without losing its form.

features.title: Elevated and easy to clean
features.text: The raised base and sturdy PVC legs keep your floor easy to sweep and mop—no heavy lifting, no hassle.

name: Glee 1-Seater Synthetic Leather Sofa
